analysis.title: [UBS Private Markets Roundup] Week of 16 Nov
key_insights: Google Threat Intelligence Group reports LLM frameworks fully automating vulnerability discovery and exploitation with no human in the loop. Disclosed vulnerabilities and exploits nearly doubled from January to August, and monthly zero-day exploits rose from a 2025 average of eight to 22 in August.

UBS's Roger Boyd says OpenAI's forthcoming cyber model scored 77% on ExploitGym versus 52.6% for GPT-6 Cyber. UBS sees limited direct overlap today between OpenAI and Tenable, Qualys and Rapid7, but says increasingly capable agents make that boundary worth watching.

Last week's outages at Microsoft, Apple, Chase, United Airlines, the FAA and an NSA network were not found by US officials to be coordinated or hostile. Causes ranged from software problems to aging infrastructure.

UBS argues near-term physical AI value comes from proven automation and enabling technologies, not humanoids. UBS estimates more than 2mn humanoids by 2035 and 300mn+ by 2050. UBS HOLT finds the strongest recent CFROI revisions across its automation subthemes in Robotics & Physical AI.

Novarc Technologies reports 3-5x productivity on carbon-steel pipe, up to 12x on stainless steel, repair rates below 1% and typical 6-12 month payback. It announced a $50m Series B and reported 147% three-year revenue growth. Its NovAI layer can extend onto third-party robots from Yaskawa and ABB.

PitchBook puts defense PE deal value at $9.7bn in the first nine months of 2026, up 180% YoY, with space and satellite systems taking the largest share. Saronic supplies the US Marine Corps an autonomous vessel, and HD Hyundai and Anduril launched a 600-ton autonomous surface vessel.
Kalshi is reportedly discussing financing at a $65bn valuation, is looking at compute futures and has acquired a securities firm to expand into stock trading.

Variational raised $110mn at a $1.5bn valuation for blockchain-based derivatives across crypto, stocks, commodities and pre-IPO companies. It generated $75mn of annualized net revenue from August to November according to company data.

The CFTC ordered Kalshi to halt Trump 'mention' markets over manipulation concerns. A former Trump teleprompter operator agreed to pay more than $172,000 to settle allegations of using advance knowledge of speeches to profit on Kalshi.

Nvidia and NVentures participated in more than 120 startup financings this year. Nvidia's private-company stakes are worth $65.5bn, up from $22bn in January, after $58bn of equity purchases in the first nine months of this fiscal year versus $5bn a year earlier.

Interim CEO Colette Kress says Nvidia will keep providing financing assistance to strong customers while 'rigorously evaluating' future investments, commitments and guarantees as other sources of capital become available.

UBS secondary privates flow: better to buy OpenAI, Stripe, Harvey, Supabase. Better for sale: Discord, WHOOP, Tether, Perplexity, Helion. Bytedance two sided, Ripple two ways with buy skew, Fanatics and ShieldAI in-the-wire sellers.

UBS Houston Energy Day: four large private E&Ps across the Eagle Ford, Haynesville, Bakken and Permian showed limited appetite to ramp activity given oil-price uncertainty and near-term gas headwinds. M&A economics are challenging at current commodity prices.
UBS Private Credit podcast: rates continue to rise and spreads are finally responding.

UBS agentic commerce discussion (Visa, Velocity, Zilch): card networks remain well positioned for consumer transactions, while stablecoins and programmable rails may gain traction in settlement, treasury, cross-border and high-frequency B2B use cases.
UBS Q-Series Automation & Robotics maps 524 global stocks. UBS estimates the autonomous logistics and warehousing robotics market at $34.5B in 2035, a 10-year CAGR of 22.7% per third-party data.

Reported private financings in the note include Fireworks AI $1.5bn Series D at $17.5bn, Tempo $500m Series A at $5bn, Glean $150m Series F at $7.2bn, Rogo about $190m at about $2bn, SandboxAQ $5.75bn post-money, and Multiverse Computing $570m Series C.

tension_points.bull_case: Better models can find and fix vulnerabilities faster. OpenAI's forthcoming cyber model scored 77% on ExploitGym versus 52.6% for GPT-6 Cyber, and Daybreak Factory extends into testing, prioritization and remediation.
tension_points.bear_case: Attackers also gain leverage. Google Threat Intelligence Group has seen LLM frameworks fully automating vulnerability discovery and exploitation, and monthly zero-day exploits rose to 22 in August from a 2025 average of eight.

tension_points.bull_case: Kalshi's CEO argues that what a president says can move markets, so predicting those words can contain genuine economic information.
tension_points.bear_case: The CFTC ordered Kalshi to halt Trump 'mention' markets over manipulation concerns, citing that outcomes can depend on the conduct of a single person.
